{{Quote|Allayloo ta nuv!|Ewokese for "Celebrate the love!"|<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
The '''Festival of Love''' was a celebration held once a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], to honor the kinship and love between tribe members. During the festival, Ewoks would give gifts of [[Cambylictus berry|camby berries]] to one another to demonstrate trust and acceptance. Tribe members would also prepare meals, sing, and dance. One popular beverage served during the celebration was [[Chak juice]]. Although primarily celebrated on Endor for obvious reasons, it also was celebrated on other planets, including [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==History==
During one such celebration in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Kylantha]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] invited [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]] and his [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|tribe]] to visit her city. Chirpa accepted and traveled to [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], along with the [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]], [[Logray/Legends|Logray]]. As news of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] had not yet reached the Ewoks, the pair were equally welcoming to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] alike. The second annual celebration for the festival on Naboo occurred at the Oceanside city of [[Kaadara]].

During subsequent annual events, the Ewoks once again celebrated across the galaxy, this time in [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]], [[Kaadara]], and the [[Southern Ewok Lake Village]] on Endor. During these celebrations, [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] were tasked with participating in [[L-O53|matchmaking]] between couples, bundling love cards for Ewok children, and helping a disillusioned love sage rediscover the true meaning of love. By completing these tasks, spacers were awarded [[Chak heart]]s which could be turned in for a variety of gifts. Spacers also made an effort to find an Ewok named [[Kyoopid]], honoring him during this time of love.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SWG-EwokFestivalofLove2010.jpg|thumb|Ewoks celebrating]]
The Festival of Love was a live event held annually in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. It usually took place in the month of [[February]]. It was based on the real-world celebration [[Wikipedia:Valentine's Day|Valentine's Day]].
